source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#9
statement_en: For arbitrary sequences $x_n,y_n$, the inequalities $$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \liminf_{n\to \infty} y_n\leq \liminf_{n\to \infty}(x_n+y_n)\leq \liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n$$ and $$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty}(x_n+y_n)\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n$$ hold.
key_techniques: order properties of limsup and liminf
callout_body: 对任意序列$x_n,y_n$，成立不等式$$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \liminf_{n\to \infty} y_n\leq \liminf_{n\to \infty}(x_n+y_n)\leq \liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n$$以及$$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty}(x_n+y_n)\leq \limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n + \limsup_{n\to \infty} y_n$$
